basics.name: Poojan Shrivastav
basics.label: Full Stack Developer • AI Engineering Student
basics.summary: B.Tech Artificial Intelligence student (Gandhinagar Institute of Technology, 2024–2028). Dual Developer Intern under one organization: KaryaUp (company SaaS) and 13 UTOPIA (digital agency). On KaryaUp, joined an existing marketing MVP in Jul 2026 and became primary engineering contributor (~96% post-join commits). On 13 UTOPIA, built FormX, AIA, and Navkar client platforms from scratch and shipped the agency portal. Separately runs a college freelancing side hustle (Oneverce / Travebie). Runner-Up at Build With AI Ahmedabad for OpenBridge.

bullets: Dual internship in one organization: KaryaUp SaaS product engineering + 13 UTOPIA digital agency client delivery.

KaryaUp (SaaS): joined Jul 2026 on an existing website MVP; became primary engineering contributor (~96% of post-join commits). Built Analytics HQ, S3/CloudFront media, Vercel SPA migration; productionized KAI, homepage, geo pricing, and SPA SEO.
13 UTOPIA (Agency): built FormX, AIA, and Navkar client platforms from scratch; also shipped the 13 UTOPIA agency portal (mobile nav, SEO, Vercel static deploy).
College freelancing venture with a friend (separate from internship): shipped Travebie (travebie.com), an AI travel platform with a 19-intent engine and 18 dynamic chat card UI components.
Added Playwright E2E coverage across booking/planner flows and PWA offline caching with a React Native admin companion.
